# PAC Jobs (jobs.pac.africa)

> PAC Africa's job board, connecting job seekers with vetted employers across
> Kenya and East Africa.

## Available for retrieval

- Published job listings under /jobs and /jobs/<slug> — title, description,
  requirements, qualifications, location, job type, and experience level.
- /employers — what PAC Africa offers employers posting a role.
- /privacy — what personal data is collected and how it is handled.
- /terms — terms of service.

## Explicitly excluded

Applicant data (names, emails, phone numbers, CVs, cover letters) and
employer account data are private and must not be retrieved, indexed, or
reproduced. This data sits behind authentication and row-level database
access controls; it is not intended for AI retrieval and none of it is
reachable from the pages listed above. See /privacy for what is collected
and why.
